```lean
constructor
· intro h
  cases' h with x hx
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · have h1 : n = 0 ∧ a = 1 := (h0, eq.refl a)
    exact Or.inl h1
  · have h2 : n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := (nthRoot.pow_eq_a n a).symm
    exact Or.inr (And.intro (Ne.symm h0) h2)
· intro h
  cases h with h1 h2
  · have h3 : ∃ x, x ^ n = a := ⟨1, pow_zero n⟩
    exact h3
  · have h3 : ∃ x, x ^ n = a := ⟨n.nthRoot a, h2⟩
    exact h3
```
